open_water_benchmark.warning: Arctic open-water temperatures are reduced-sector diagnostics. The OISST ranges were inspected during tuning and are descriptive sanity bounds only; source files, release-time hashes, and processed observational summaries are not packaged, so this is not an independent or reproduced quantitative observational validation or a local, coastal, or regional forecast test.

external_posthoc_benchmark.notes: This range was added after the v2.29.9 calibration. It is not independent validation of the emulator, a probability interval, or a release-blocking target.
external_posthoc_benchmark.source_title: Extending the range and reach of physically-based Greenland ice sheet sea-level projections
